The banner in the footer is Appodeal's, so the ad SDK is never brought up; 1DM's own promo banner, including the built-in "install 1DM+" ad and the server-driven fallback banner (defaultBannerViewNew), is suppressed at its source, never rendered, and its footer slot is collapsed.
name: Disable home screen ads

description: Skip ADM's automatic rating prompt. The menu item that opens the same dialog on request is left intact.
name: Disable rating prompts

description: Load the original full-resolution asset for pin images instead of the 736x rendition, at the cost of considerably more data.
name: Force original image download

description: Make Djezzy's Walk & Win counter read 10,000 with no walk at all, by forcing the stored step total itself rather than the pedometer event stream. The card's figures are lifetime accumulators read back out of storage, so an event delivered before a walk is never counted.
name: Force Walk & Win steps to 10000

description: Hide the suggested-topics section shown under a pin.
name: Hide "Ideas you might love" section

description: Hide the comments button on a pin, so comments cannot be opened from the pin.
name: Hide comments

description: Hide the create (+) button in the bottom navigation bar.
name: Hide Create nav button

description: Hide the notifications button in the bottom navigation bar.
name: Hide Notifications nav button

description: Hide the search button in the bottom navigation bar.
name: Hide Search nav button

description: Raise the download ceilings to 32 simultaneous downloads and 64 connections per download, and set torrent defaults to 500 global and 100 per torrent.
name: Increase connection limits

description: Add the "Morphe" entry to the Account Settings list, opening the Morphe settings screen.
name: Morphe settings entry

description: Rename the reused string resource to "Morphe" in every shipped language, so the settings entry is identifiable.
name: Morphe settings screen (label)

description: Register the Morphe settings activity in the manifest, with an intent-filter for the morphe:// scheme.
name: Morphe settings screen (manifest)

description: Return a random advertising ID instead of the real one, so the app has no advertising identifier to hand to Pinterest or to any bundled tracker.
name: Neutralize advertising ID

description: Unlocks AAAD Pro subscription features by bypassing Stripe and Firebase subscription checks.
name: AAAD Premium

description: Disables AAAD's anti-tamper, anti-debug, and integrity checks to allow running on patched installations.
name: AAAD Security Bypass

description: Allows screenshots and screen recording in all conversations including end-to-end encrypted ones.
name: Allow screen capture

description: Makes Google Photos dark surfaces true black.
name: AMOLED dark theme
